title: Isandro and the Weather
author: Vesper Okafor
blurb: Silas Thornbury, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
